name: 3-Bike Blue Devil Hitch Mounted Bicycle Carrier Rack
description: Blue Devil series hitch-mounted bicycle rack carries (1) to (3) bikes using an existing vehicle trailer hitch. The BC-7626-2+1 works with 2" Class III/IV hitch receivers and includes removable adapter for use with 1.25" Class I/II hitch receivers. Bicycles are secured to the hitch rack in rubber cradles by Velcro straps, a bicycle tie-down strap is included to secure bikes together and to the rack. Works with bikes weighing up to 33 lbs. each, with a maximum 2" frame diameter. Made with heavy duty steel construction, finished in a smooth black for long lasting durability. Please note: The hitch bike rack features a pull-pin and pivot system, allowing the rack to swing downward when unloaded for rear tailgate and hatch access. For safety, it's not recommended to swing the bicycle rack down with bikes attached in order to eliminate excess strain on the pivot bolt.

name: Thule Parkway 2 Bike Rack for 2" Hitches - Tilting
description: Features: Hitch-mounted rack carries up to 2 bikes Cushioned cradles hold the bikes firmly on the carrier while protecting the frames from scratches and abrasions Soft rubber straps keep bikes secured to cradles, helping to prevent bike-to-bike contact Rotating, sliding cradles adjust along arms for perfect bike positioning Upgrade to anti-sway cradles by adding 1 No-Sway Cage and 1 strap (sold separately) per bike postion Dual arms make loading easy and offer excellent bike support Pull pin allows you to tilt the rack forward for easy access to your rear cargo area Built-in anti-rattle device reduces vibration and noise of the bike carrier in the hitch Snug-Tite hitch lock (THSTL2; sold separately) secures carrier to hitch Included strap reduces movement of handlebars and wheels during transport High-strength steel construction is perfect for travel over rugged terrain Made in USA Specs: Carrying capacity: 2 bikes Weight capacity: 70 lbs Application: 2" x 2" trailer hitch receivers Distance between rack arms (outside to outside): 12-1/4" Length of rack arms: 22" Cradle width: 1-5/8" Distance from center of hitch pin hole to upright bar of the carrier: 9-3/4" Distance from center of hitch pin hole to foot of carrier: 5-1/8" Distance from end of receiver to center of hitch pin hole: 2-5/8" Hitch bolt length: 1-1/2" Limited lifetime warranty Note: This dual-arm rack reduces the need for a bike frame adapter bar (sold separately) to mount a children's, women's, or alternative frame bicycle. However, to mount certain bikes or to keep your bike level on the rack, a bike adapter bar may be required. Most step-through bikes, dual-suspension bikes, and small children's bikes will require a bike adapter bar. The Thule Parkway is the perfect hitch-mounted bike rack for weekend warriors and part-time riders. The simple, solid design offers a great option for basic bike transportation.
